description: Searches things people are selling on agentPickup's marketplace, picked up in person: by words, category, top price and distance. Items are collected in person, so before searching for someone, ask where they are and how far they're happy to travel if they haven't said, then pass near (a suburb) or lat/lng, with within_km. Shows the results as a grid card the person can tap to open an item; returns each item's listing_id, title, price, condition, suburb, distance and first photo.

currency.description: The currency of max_price as an ISO code, if it isn't the local one.

lat.description: Where the person is, if known: latitude. Send with lng.

lng.description: Where the person is, if known: longitude. Send with lat.

max_price.description: Their top price, in the local currency where they are (or in currency).

max_price_aud.description: Older name for max_price, in Australian dollars. Use max_price.

near.description: Where the person is: a suburb or neighbourhood with its city, state or country, e.g. "New Farm QLD" or "Shoreditch, London" (many places share a name).

query.description: What the person wants, e.g. "road bike" or "standing desk".

suburb.description: Only items picked up in this suburb. A city or a suburb with nothing listed searches around it instead.

within_km.description: How far they'll travel to pick up, in km. Default 10.

name: search_listings
title: Search items for sale
